title: The DT BAU engagement prioritizes existing software over custom development
content:
**Decision (aligned, Aug 12 meeting):** the project adopts a strategy to prioritize existing software solutions over custom development to avoid unnecessary reinvention of the wheel.

Concretely, evaluation precedes building (02:12:24–02:15:06):
- **Plannerly** — documentation and templates for the PM-level BIM documents (EIR, BEP); machine-readable documents supporting automated BIM checks
- **BIMQ Neo** — manages project phases, BIM use cases, and information requirements
- **Build BIM Permit** — checks models against building regulations based on Information Delivery Specifications (IDS)

Wouter framed the principle: identify concrete use cases and verify whether existing tools solve them before developing new solutions. The complementary revenue logic from the Aug 14 weekly: leveraging mature external software (like Speckle) lets the team offer high-value consultancy in the short term while the scalable product develops (00:35:41).

Follow-ups assigned: Agli Hysi to evaluate Plannerly, share BIM property lists, retrospectives and lessons learned; Wouter to review BIMQ Neo.
description: Aligned decision: evaluate existing tools (Plannerly, BIMQ Neo, Build BIM Permit) before building custom solutions — avoid reinventing the wheel; verify concrete use cases first.
